messages:
sam: Heads-up: after the outbound fw change this morning ~12% of eu-west GPU nodes are failing to join. Bootstrap shows KMS decrypt errors against the privatelink endpoint.

noor: Sample log:
```
2026-04-05T09:12:17Z keystore[err] ERROR: KMS:AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/ef01
2026-04-05T09:12:17Z bootstrap[err] node bootstrap failed: keystore decrypt failed
```

ops-bot: Alert: node-join-failures eu-west > baseline by 38% in 5m. Auto-backfill triggered.

sre-oncall: Root cause looks like two things: 1) new default-deny egress rule blocks the privatelink IPs used during join, and 2) the KMS key policy was tightened to require SourceVpcEndpoint == vpce-0prod, but DNS failover sent some joins to vpce-0staging.

sam: Quick mitigation options: temporary egress exception for the specific vpce IPs for gpu-join subnets (audit-friendly), or relax KMS policy (requires security approval). Temporary fw exception is fastest.

noor: Proposed immediate steps:
1) add egress allow to 10.4.2.14/32:443 for sg-gpu-join (30m window)
2) restart keystore-agent on joining instances `systemctl restart keystore-agent`
3) capture VPC flow logs + endpoint logs and attach to infra-audit ticket
4) open follow-up to update key policy to include the staging vpce ARN or remove vpce condition in favor of a stricter IAM principal check

sre-oncall: Please include exact timestamps and flowlog query `fields srcaddr,dstaddr,action | filter dstaddr==10.4.2.14 and dstport==443` in the ticket. We'll require an audit PR and incident marker.

noor: Running quick commands now (added to ticket):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-gpu-join --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.4.2.14/32 --description "temp allow KMS privatelink for gpu joins"
fleetctl run --filter 'tag:subnet=gpu-join and state:joining' 'systemctl restart keystore-agent'
```

ops-bot: Action logged: ephemeral egress rule created at 3223456792 by noor.

noor: Seeing decrypt successes on 9/12 nodes:
```
2026-04-05T09:18:01Z keystore[info] INFO: Decrypt succeeded for instance i-0b2
2026-04-05T09:18:04Z bootstrap[info] node joined cluster: i-0b2
```

finance: Cost note: cross-region backfill would have added ~ $1.4k/day if sustained. Short rollback for 30m is cheaper.

security: We'll review the proposed key policy change. For now document the window and re-tighten after evidence captured.

sam: Rolled back (exception applied) at 3223456792. Leaving it for 30m, monitoring. Will post when re-tightened.

ops-bot: Node-join failures trending down. Autobalancer throttles reduced.

noor: Re-tightened firewall at 3223456985 after capturing flowlogs and attaching to infra-audit PR infra/terraform#3750. All nodes healthy.

sre-oncall: Follow-ups: (1) patch key policy to allow the staging vpce or switch to IAM-only predicate, (2) add a canary that exercises join path against all vpce endpoints in staging, (3) doc the incident in infra-audit (timestamps, flowlogs, evidence).
